dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Lauma</color> might like to hear about the Feast of the Moon...)

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Hello, would you like to— Whoa! Lady Lauma, what brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Thank you for your work, Lyylikki. Has the distribution of the "Feast of the Moon" gone well today?

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Yes, well indeed! Both cooking and handing out the meals went just perfectly!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: We haven't had any more troublemakers or line-cutters since Miss Jahoda came to help out for a few days. Everyone lines up nicely for their meals now!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Before that, there was a big guy who kept causing problems — cutting the queue and grabbing multiple portions... Poor Mr. Kantor tried to stop him, and was hit a few times for his trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: That day, Miss Jahoda happened to be there getting her meal. When she saw that thug causing trouble, she jumped up and kicked him so hard he fell!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Having knocked him flat, she even caught the unopened meal midair — not a thing was spilled! Then she pointed at the man lying on the ground and said...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: "If you have no respect for your benefactors or your food, then you can go hungry today. Now outta the way — or was one kick not enough for you?"

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: After that, she helped me distribute meals for many days... I made her lots of delicious food as thanks for that.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: An act that deserves gratitude indeed. Perhaps... I really should hire a guard to assist you, like I mentioned before.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Eh? No, there's no need for that! We're already short on manpower. We should just open another distribution point instead.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Besides, things are really well organized nowadays. Miss Jahoda still stops by from time to time, and between her and Mr. Kantor, I doubt anyone would stir up further trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Let us hope so. In that case, I'll have some friends take turns coming over. If you need help, just tell them.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Friends...? They live on the island too, I assume. Do I know them?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe, I am sure you do.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Well then, I shall leave you to you work. See you again, Lyylikki. May the Moon Goddess guard your path.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Lady Lauma!
